description: Both processor config consumers must combine scarf and spiral flags for seam tracking while preserving extrusion moves.

mutants.description: Ignore the scarf-seam boolean in the PrintConfig overload; the full-config true/spiral-false case must still emit the seam.
Ignore the scarf-seam boolean in the DynamicPrintConfig overload; the dynamic true/spiral-false case must still emit the seam.
Replace the PrintConfig overload OR with scarf assignment; the false/true row must retain the seam because spiral mode is enabled.
Replace the DynamicPrintConfig overload OR with scarf assignment; the false/true row must retain the seam because spiral mode is enabled.
